definitions.gloss: stomach and intestines; digestive organs; gastrointestinal tract
definitions.explanation: Refers collectively to the stomach and intestines, or more broadly to the digestive system. Commonly used when discussing digestive health.

examples.japanese: {胃腸|いちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
{胃腸|いちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I have a weak stomach, so I can't eat spicy food.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胃腸|いちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Stress can reduce the functioning of the digestive system.

notes:
USAGE:
{胃腸|いちょう} is the standard everyday term for the digestive tract. Japanese people frequently talk about {胃腸|いちょう} health, especially in relation to stress, seasonal changes, and diet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃腸|いちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (to have a weak stomach)
- {胃腸|いちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧ (condition of the stomach)
- {胃腸|いちょう}{薬|やく} (gastrointestinal medicine)
- {胃腸|いちょう}{炎|えん} (gastroenteritis)
- {胃腸|いちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧だ (to have a strong stomach)
